                    tx = t.get("x")
                    ty = t.get("y")
                    if tx is not None and ty is not None:
                        targets.append((tx, ty))

    # Move toward the closest target if available
    if targets:

            return [dx, dy]

    dy = 0

        dx = 1 if x < 0 else -1
    if y != 0:

    # Clip to ensure within -1..1
    dx = -1 if dx < -1 else (1 if dx > 1 else dx)
    dy = -1 if dy < -1 else (1 if dy > 1 else dy)

    return [dx, dy]
